name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
summary: At Booty Bay, the Bloodsail Buccaneers’ plans now point to a camp and an attack signal.

sections.title: A Plot Revealed
sections.body: A map marks the Bloodsail Buccaneers’ intended camp in Booty Bay with a red X. Their orders call for silence. The crew must kill anyone who approaches and wait for a signal from the southern command post before attacking.

sections.title: Reporting to the Harbor
sections.body: You carry the findings back to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay. He sent you to scout, and the pirates are still waiting for the signal before they attack.

faq.q: What is written on the Bloodsail correspondence?
faq.answer: The recovered Bloodsail Buccaneers correspondence orders the crew to camp quietly at the marked spot, kill anyone who approaches, and wait for a signal from their southern command post before attacking.

aliases: what does the red x mean
faq.answer: A red X on the map of Booty Bay marks the pirates’ intended camp.

faq.q: Who needs to hear about this discovery?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay needs to hear of the discovery. He sent you to scout the area.

faq.q: What came before finding this correspondence?
faq.answer: First Mate Crazz first sent you from Booty Bay to investigate the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
